newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia condemns Israeli schoolgirl shooting.
newsitem.headline: Australia condemns Israeli schoolgirl shooting.

text.p: Australia's deputy prime minister, who was meeting Israeli leader Benjamin Netanyahu when news came that seven Israeli schoolgirls had been gunned down in Jordan, said the attack was "a shocking atrocity".
Tim Fischer, on a visit to Israel in his role as trade minister, said the Israeli prime minister reacted "with shock, with anger" when told of Thursday's attack.

"It is a shocking atrocity and I certainly condemn terrorism in all its forms and I did so on behalf of the Australian government today in Jerusalem," Deputy Prime Minister Tim Fischer told Australian radio in an interview from Jerusalem.
The seven schoolgirls died when a Jordanian soldier fired on them as they were on an outing to a Israeli-Jordanian border site called "The Island of Peace".
Fischer urged all sides not to let the indicident derail the peace process.
